output_fields.name: url
output_fields.description: The direct URL of the Facebook Marketplace listing page

output_fields.name: title
output_fields.description: The title of the listing as posted by the seller

output_fields.name: initial_price
output_fields.description: The original listed price of the item before any discounts

output_fields.name: final_price
output_fields.description: The current or discounted price of the item

output_fields.name: currency
output_fields.description: The currency in which the price is listed

output_fields.name: product_id
output_fields.description: The unique identifier assigned to the listing by Facebook Marketplace.

output_fields.name: breadcrumbs
output_fields.description: A list of navigation breadcrumb items representing the category hierarchy of the listing

output_fields.name: condition
output_fields.description: The condition of the listed item as reported by the seller

output_fields.name: description
output_fields.description: The full textual description of the listing, as written by the seller

output_fields.name: location
output_fields.description: The general location

output_fields.name: country_code
output_fields.description: The two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code

output_fields.name: root_category
output_fields.description: The root category the listing belongs to on Facebook Marketplace

output_fields.name: images
output_fields.description: A list of URLs pointing to the listing's product images uploaded by the seller

output_fields.name: seller_description
output_fields.description: A short bio or description from the seller's Facebook Marketplace profile

output_fields.name: color
output_fields.description: The color of the listed item, if applicable and provided by the seller

output_fields.name: brand
output_fields.description: The brand or manufacturer of the listed item, if applicable

output_fields.name: videos
output_fields.description: A list of URLs pointing to any video content uploaded by the seller as part of the listing

output_fields.name: profile_id
output_fields.description: The unique Facebook profile ID of the seller who posted the listing

output_fields.name: listing_date
output_fields.description: The date and time when the listing was originally posted on Facebook Marketplace

output_fields.name: car_miles
output_fields.description: The mileage of the vehicle as reported by the seller. Only relevant for car/vehicle listings

output_fields.name: is_sold
output_fields.description: Indicates whether the product is sold

output_fields.name: transmission
output_fields.description: Transmission type shown in vehicle details. Only relevant for car/vehicle listings
